9: # AI Marketing Videos
10: 
11: Create professional marketing videos via [inference.sh](https://inference.sh) CLI.
12: 
13: ![AI Marketing Videos](https://cloud.inference.sh/app/files/u/4mg21r6ta37mpaz6ktzwtt8krr/01kg2c0egyg243mnyth4y6g51q.jpeg)
14: 
15: ## Quick Start
16: 
17: > Requires inference.sh CLI (`belt`). [Install instructions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inference-sh/skills/refs/heads/main/cli-install.md)
18: 
19: ```bash
20: belt login
21: 
22: # Generate a product promo video
23: belt app run google/veo-3-1-fast --input '{
24:   "prompt": "Sleek product reveal video, smartphone emerging from light particles, premium tech aesthetic, commercial quality"
25: }'
26: ```
27: 
28: 
29: ## Video Ad Types
30: 
31: | Type | Duration | Platform |
32: |------|----------|----------|
33: | Bumper Ad | 6 seconds | YouTube |
34: | Short Ad | 15 seconds | Instagram, Facebook |
35: | Standard Ad | 30 seconds | YouTube, TV |
36: | Explainer | 60-90 seconds | Website, YouTube |
37: | Product Demo | 30-60 seconds | All platforms |
38: 
39: ## Marketing Video Templates
40: 
41: ### Product Launch
42: 
43: ```bash
44: # Dramatic product reveal
45: belt app run google/veo-3 --input '{
46:   "prompt": "Cinematic product launch video, premium tech device floating in space, dramatic lighting, particles and light effects, Apple-style reveal, commercial quality"
47: }'
48: ```
49: 
50: ### Brand Story
51: 
52: ```bash
53: # Emotional brand narrative
54: belt app run google/veo-3-1 --input '{
55:   "prompt": "Brand story video showing diverse people connecting through technology, warm color grading, lifestyle montage, emotional and inspiring, commercial"
56: }'
57: ```
58: 
59: ### Feature Highlight
60: 
61: ```bash
62: # Focus on specific feature
63: belt app run bytedance/seedance-2-0 --input '{
64:   "prompt": "Close-up product feature demonstration, hands interacting with device, clean background, informative, tech commercial style",
65:   "generate_audio": true
66: }'
67: ```
68: 
69: ### Testimonial Style
70: 
71: ```bash
72: # Talking head testimonial
73: belt app run google/veo-3-1-fast --input '{
74:   "prompt": "Customer testimonial style video, person speaking to camera, neutral office background, professional lighting, authentic feel"
75: }'
76: ```
77: 
78: ### Before/After
79: 
80: ```bash
81: # Transformation reveal
82: belt app run google/veo-3-1-fast --input '{
83:   "prompt": "Before and after transformation video, split screen transition, dramatic reveal, satisfying comparison, commercial style"
84: }'
85: ```
86: 
87: ## Complete Ad Workflows
88: 
89: ### 30-Second Product Ad
90: 
91: ```bash
92: # 1. Opening hook (0-3s)
93: belt app run google/veo-3-1-fast --input '{
94:   "prompt": "Attention-grabbing opening, product silhouette in dramatic lighting, building anticipation"
95: }' > hook.json
96: 
97: # 2. Problem statement (3-8s)
98: belt app run google/veo-3-1-fast --input '{
99:   "prompt": "Frustrated person dealing with common problem, relatable everyday situation, documentary style"
100: }' > problem.json
101: 
102: # 3. Solution reveal (8-15s)
103: belt app run google/veo-3-1-fast --input '{
104:   "prompt": "Product reveal with features highlighted, clean demonstration, solving the problem shown before"
105: }' > solution.json
106: 
107: # 4. Benefits showcase (15-25s)
108: belt app run google/veo-3-1-fast --input '{
109:   "prompt": "Happy customer using product, lifestyle integration, multiple quick cuts showing benefits"
110: }' > benefits.json
111: 
112: # 5. Call to action (25-30s)
113: belt app run google/veo-3-1-fast --input '{
114:   "prompt": "Product hero shot with space for text overlay, professional lighting, commercial ending"
115: }' > cta.json
116: 
117: # 6. Generate voiceover
118: belt app run infsh/kokoro-tts --input '{
119:   "prompt": "Tired of [problem]? Introducing [Product]. [Key benefit 1]. [Key benefit 2]. [Key benefit 3]. Get yours today.",
120:   "voice": "af_nicole"
121: }' > voiceover.json
122: 
123: # 7. Merge all clips with voiceover
124: belt app run infsh/media-merger --input '{
125:   "videos": ["<hook>", "<problem>", "<solution>", "<benefits>", "<cta>"],
126:   "audio_url": "<voiceover>",
127:   "transition": "crossfade"
128: }'
129: ```
130: 
131: ### Instagram/TikTok Ad (15s)
132: 
133: ```bash
134: # Vertical format, fast-paced
135: belt app run google/veo-3-1-fast --input '{
136:   "prompt": "Fast-paced product showcase, vertical 9:16, quick cuts, trending style, hook in first 2 seconds, satisfying visually, Gen-Z aesthetic"
137: }'
138: 
139: # Add trendy music
140: belt app run infsh/media-merger --input '{
141:   "video_url": "<video>",
142:   "audio_url": "https://trending-music.mp3"
143: }'
144: ```
145: 
146: ### Explainer Video
147: 
148: ```bash
149: # 1. Write script
150: belt app run openrouter/claude-sonnet-45 --input '{
151:   "prompt": "Write a 60-second explainer video script for a SaaS product. Include: hook, problem, solution, 3 key features, social proof, CTA. Make it conversational."
152: }' > script.json
153: 
154: # 2. Generate visuals for each section
155: SECTIONS=("hook" "problem" "solution" "feature1" "feature2" "feature3" "social_proof" "cta")
156: 
157: for section in "${SECTIONS[@]}"; do
158:   belt app run google/veo-3-1-fast --input "{
159:     \"prompt\": \"Explainer video scene for $section, motion graphics style, clean modern aesthetic, SaaS product\"
160:   }" > "$section.json"
161: done
162: 
163: # 3. Generate professional voiceover
164: belt app run infsh/kokoro-tts --input '{
165:   "prompt": "<full-script>",
166:   "voice": "am_michael"
167: }' > voiceover.json
168: 
169: # 4. Assemble final video
170: belt app run infsh/media-merger --input '{
171:   "videos": ["<hook>", "<problem>", "<solution>", ...],
172:   "audio_url": "<voiceover>",
173:   "transition": "fade"
174: }'
175: ```
176: 
177: ## Platform-Specific Formats
178: 
179: ### Facebook/Instagram Feed
180: 
181: ```bash
182: belt app run google/veo-3-1-fast --input '{
183:   "prompt": "Square format product video 1:1, eye-catching visuals, works without sound, text-friendly, scroll-stopping"
184: }'
185: ```
186: 
187: ### YouTube Pre-Roll
188: 
189: ```bash
190: belt app run google/veo-3-1-fast --input '{
191:   "prompt": "YouTube ad style, skip button awareness (hook in 5 seconds), 16:9, professional commercial quality"
192: }'
193: ```
194: 
195: ### LinkedIn
196: 
197: ```bash
198: belt app run google/veo-3-1-fast --input '{
199:   "prompt": "Professional B2B product video, corporate style, clean and modern, business audience, subtle motion"
200: }'
201: ```
202: 
203: ### TikTok/Reels
204: 
205: ```bash
206: belt app run google/veo-3-1-fast --input '{
207:   "prompt": "TikTok native style ad, vertical 9:16, raw authentic feel, not overly polished, trendy, user-generated content aesthetic"
208: }'
209: ```
210: 
211: ## Ad Creative Best Practices
212: 
213: ### Hook Formula (First 3 Seconds)
214: 
215: ```bash
216: belt app run google/veo-3-1-fast --input '{
217:   "prompt": "Opening hook: [choose one]
218:   - Surprising visual transformation
219:   - Bold statement text animation
220:   - Relatable problem scenario
221:   - Curiosity gap visual
222:   - Satisfying action"
223: }'
224: ```
225: 
226: ### Visual Hierarchy
227: 
228: 1. **Product hero** - Clear, prominent
229: 2. **Benefits** - Illustrated, not just stated
230: 3. **Social proof** - Visible testimonials/numbers
231: 4. **CTA** - Clear space for text overlay
232: 
233: ### Sound Design
234: 
235: ```bash
236: # Add appropriate music
237: belt app run infsh/ai-music --input '{
238:   "prompt": "Upbeat commercial background music, modern, energetic, 30 seconds"
239: }' > music.json
240: 
241: belt app run infsh/media-merger --input '{
242:   "video_url": "<ad-video>",
243:   "audio_url": "<music>",
244:   "audio_volume": 0.5
245: }'
246: ```
247: 
248: ## A/B Testing Variants
249: 
250: ```bash
251: # Generate multiple creative variants
252: HOOKS=(
253:   "Problem-focused opening"
254:   "Product reveal opening"
255:   "Testimonial opening"
256:   "Statistic opening"
257: )
258: 
259: for hook in "${HOOKS[@]}"; do
260:   belt app run google/veo-3-1-fast --input "{
261:     \"prompt\": \"Marketing video with $hook, professional commercial quality\"
262:   }" > "variant_${hook// /_}.json"
263: done
264: ```
265: 
266: ## Video Ad Checklist
267: 
268: - [ ] Hook in first 3 seconds
269: - [ ] Works without sound (captions/text)
270: - [ ] Clear product visibility
271: - [ ] Benefit-focused messaging
272: - [ ] Single clear CTA
273: - [ ] Correct aspect ratio for platform
274: - [ ] Brand consistency
275: - [ ] Mobile-optimized
